One receipt settles multiple orders, creates one Finance movement, and retains unused credit
Individual and bulk allocation posting wait for parent receipt Finance verification and approval
Credit application is strict, durable and idempotent without another bank movement

Marketplace buyer and company settlement states reconcile independently

Buyer payment report changes no bank movement and enables later settlement
Duplicate platform payout references cannot create another receipt
Unused-credit refunds appear in statements and are separate from order allocations
External product options map to the existing SKU and commerce mapping records
External event retries deduplicate and changed payloads flag conflict without rewriting orders
Customer workspace enforces business-unit boundaries
Website provider payouts can settle another buyer account while both statements reconcile

Posted allocation correction holds operational credit until the controlled reversal is posted
